cd /app
pip install --no-cache-dir --target /tmp/packages -r requirements.txt
export PYTHONPATH="/tmp/packages:$PYTHONPATH"
python app.py

set -e
JQ_VERSION=jq-1.7.1
curl -sSfL --retry 3 \
  "https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/$${JQ_VERSION}/jq-linux-amd64" \
  -o /tmp/jq
chmod +x /tmp/jq
export PATH="/tmp:$${PATH}"
exec /scripts/run.sh

echo "Seeding missing config files from image defaults (no-clobber)"
cp -rn /app/Configs/. /pvc-configs/
echo "Enforcing git-managed Difficulty.eco"
cp /git-configs/Difficulty.eco /pvc-configs/Difficulty.eco

/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-immich-mic.doc:
Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server
  • immich-typesense
  • immich-machine-learning
  • immich-microservices (this one)

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql
